title: Bridging the Gap: A Survey on Integrating (Human) Feedback for Natural Language Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing literature on how human annotators exhibit anchoring/confirmation bias (failing to consider better alternatives) and positivity bias (giving disproportionately positive feedback) during human feedback collection.
Summarizing existing studies that observe how tuning language models with human feedback increases the alignment of generated outputs with US liberal views on controversial topics.

Discussing literature that measures the representation of different demographic groups in language model opinions, and how annotators from different cultural or demographic backgrounds disagree on toxicity and ethical judgments.
